sentences.text: This application for grant of leave to appeal under Section 378(3) of Cr.P.C., 1973 has been filed by the prosecution against the judgment of acquittal dated 30.10.2017 passed by JMFC, Dhar, in Criminal Case No.2450/2011 whereby the learned trial Court has acquitted the non-applicants for the offence punishable under Sections 16 (1) (ka) (i) read with Section (ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 for selling sub-standard packaged drinking water.
2. The prosecution could not prove before the learned trial Court that seized packaged drinking water comes under the definition of "food" under the Act.
Therefore, the learned trial Court has acquitted the accused.
Nothing contrary is demonstrated by the prosecution before this Court.
Other reasons have also been discussed by the learned trial Court, which are well supported by the evidence produced by the prosecution.
In view of the aforesaid, I do not find any incorrectness in the order of the learned Trial Court.
No case for grant of leave to appeal, as prayed, is made out.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed.

Digitally signed (Virender Singh)
 by Amit Kumar Judge amit Date: 2018.02.14  13:58:29 -08'00'
